messages:
Maria G: Quick sync — proposing a new 'leadrelay' flow for inbound claims. Idea: short claim TTL (30s) as the normal path, plus an emergency tunnel that moves the lead to a fallback queue if enrichment stalls for >5s. Keeps UX snappy but avoids lost leads. Thoughts?

Alex P: I like the timebox idea. Two questions: 1) do we honor HubSpot assignment webhooks if they come in after the TTL? 2) what happens to duplicates?

Jordan L: Agree on 30s for most cases. For duplicates we should use an idempotency check on lead external_id + source. If a late HS webhook arrives, it should reconcile but not reassign if claim already succeeded.

Sam T: Implementation note — heartbeat probe for enrichment service is critical. If enrichment hasn't acked within 3s, start warming the tunnel (pre-create fallback claim) but don't finalize until 5s. That reduces churn.

Maria G: Nice — so sequence: receive lead -> attempt enrichment -> if ack <3s continue; if 3-5s start preflight fallback; if >5s finalize fallback and notify SDR channel. Also log the enrichment delta for QA.

Alex P: For HubSpot/SF rules: we should add a short TTL flag on the claim object and persist it to our claim store. Example pseudo: ```json
{
  "claim_id": "c_123",
  "lead_id": "l_456",
  "claim_ttl": 30,
  "fallback_started_at": null
}
```
Then a background reconciler handles late webhooks.

Jordan L: +1 on reconciler. Also add a metric: leadrelay.fallback_rate and leadrelay.late_webhook_reconcile_count. Dashboards to alert if fallback_rate > 2% over 5m.

hubspot-bot: webhook received for lead l_456 (event: contact.created) status: delivered

Sam T: One more — round-robin pool should mark preflighted claims as 'reserved' for 60s so we don't double-assign while enrichment is happening. If enrichment completes, flip to 'active'. If fallback finalizes, release reservation.

Maria G: Great. Action items: Alex to update webhook reconcilier spec, Jordan to add metrics & dashboard, Sam to prototype reservation TTL logic. I'll draft a short playbook for ops including how to manually move leads out of the tunnel. Target: ship to staging this week. :thumbsup:

Alex P: I'll start a PR for the reconcilier spec and attach a sample flow diagram.

Jordan L: I'll stub the metrics in Grafana and add alert thresholds.

Sam T: Prototype ETA end of day Friday.

Maria G: Thanks team. I'll post the playbook draft here when ready.
